text:
maria: Heads up — nightly evals for quantized-3b show ~7.8% drop on the story_continuation set vs yesterday. Failures are weird: mid-sentence truncation or abrupt topic jumps. Started after last night's runtime push (fused-kernel merge).
kevin: Saw the same. Quick eyeball: token-level probs shifted around sampling time. Could be RNG/order or kv-cache interaction, not a training regression.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-19T02:11:34 by kevin: fused-kernel-merge (commit ab12ef) -> canary. :rocket:
sasha: Can you paste a failing example + quant config (group size, int8/4/16)?
maria: Example (good -> bad):
```
prompt: "The explorer opened the door and saw a strange machine humming. He reached out and..."
good (fp16, before merge): "...felt a warm pulse. The device displayed a map and the coordinates glowed, guiding him toward the northern ridge."
bad (quantized-3b, after merge): "...felt a warm pulse. Then suddenly the report showed 0 errors. End of story."
config: quant=int8, group=128, sampling: top_p=0.92, top_k=50, seed=42
```
li: Interesting — I dumped the logits before sampling for that prompt. There's a tiny reorder in cumulative sums causing different tie-breaks around token 234-236. Diff snippet: 
```
before: [..., -0.12, -0.11, -0.10, -0.09] 
after:  [..., -0.11, -0.12, -0.10, -0.09]
```
kevin: That matches my local reproducer. I ran with seed=42 and deterministic sampling disabled and got the derailment. Hypothesis: fused merge changed accumulation associativity -> tiny fp errors -> different token ranking -> cascaded sampling divergence.
sasha: Quick isolation: can we run the canary with two toggles — (1) force fp16 compute path on that model, (2) deterministic sampling (no top-k randomness) — to see if quant + reorder combo is the culprit?
maria: Kicked off a canary rerun with deterministic_sampling=true and fp16_fallback=true for that model. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/9843 (started). Will post diffs when done.
deploy-bot: Job 9843: quant-eval-rerun started by maria at 2026-03-19T03:02:10.
li: If deterministic fixes it, we should bisect commits between ab12ef and 9c3d70 (previous stable). Also try toggle kv-cache-serialize-order back to old implementation — that should isolate reorder vs quant.
kevin: I'll open a revert flag PR to flip the reorder boolean and attach the nightly eval diff. If that reduces the regression we can plan a proper fix.
sasha: Thanks — @maria can you add the failing prompts to the regression set and pin them to the nightly alert dashboard?
maria: Adding now. Will also collect a small suite of 20 failing seeds to block the merged change if needed. :white_check_mark:
